document_metadata.title: 1、INT. COCKPIT (EDEN) - CONT.
document_metadata.summary: An insane officer initiates launch of sleep pods while ignoring a trapped colleague's desperate pleas, after fatally attacking another; bloodied and emotionless, he seals himself in his pod as the ship's systems activate.

document_metadata.title: 4、INT. SLEEP CHAMBER COMPARTMENT - CONT.
document_metadata.summary: Bower finds two adjacent sleep pods, one empty and one occupied by Lt. Payton; his name is on his pod but unfamiliar. Dusty terminals and trembling hands heighten his disorientation and fear.

entities.name: Bower escapes from his sealed sleep pod
entities.description: Bower violently opens the hatch of his glass-enclosed sleep pod, scrambles out, and struggles to free himself from attached feeding tubes.

entities.name: Bower collapses on the floor after exiting the pod
entities.description: Immediately after escaping the pod, Bower hits the floor naked and gasping, unable to support himself as his legs wobble and give out.

entities.name: Bower experiences intense physical distress and disorientation
entities.description: Bower's body reacts violently to awakening—sweating profusely, muscles twitching, voice echoing in the dark as he struggles to understand his surroundings.

entities.name: Bower discovers his hair has turned white
entities.description: Upon regaining some awareness, Bower notices that his short-cropped hair is now completely white, indicating a significant physical transformation.

entities.name: Bower calls out for help in the dark chamber
entities.description: Bower shouts into the darkness, attempting to locate or attract the attention of other people, but receives no response.

entities.name: Bower activates a glow stick to illuminate the room
entities.description: After fumbling through the dark and failing to power terminals, Bower snaps a glow stick into operation, casting light on the high-tech, cavernous environment.

entities.name: Bower attempts to drink fluid from his feeding tube
entities.description: Bower returns to his sleep pod, retrieves the detached feeding tube, and sucks liquid from it, initially heaving but forcing himself to continue drinking.

entities.summary: A man awakens in a derelict spacecraft with no memory, discovers his identity via a tattoo and locker, and is assisted by a corporal who awoke earlier to manage systems and support him.

entities.name: Payton
entities.description: An individual aboard the ship whom Bower is attempting to contact through radio communication.
entities.summary: A lieutenant from Flight Team Five awakens in a sealed sleep pod aboard the Elysium, disoriented and suffering memory loss. He struggles physically, requires support, and takes charge at the control desk before deciding to leave due to power failures and strange noises, expressing caution about descending into a narrow shaft.

entities.name: radio
entities.description: A communication device used by Bower to attempt contact with Payton, receiving only static in response.

entities.name: Bower notices an out-of-place rounded shape in the side corridor
entities.description: As Bower walks through the corridor, he pauses and observes a strange, rounded shape fifty yards away that disrupts the symmetrical steel framing, prompting him to investigate cautiously.

entities.name: Bower discovers a dead man hanging in a doorway
entities.description: Bower approaches and identifies the strange shape as a naked, gutted man hanging by a cable around his neck, his face swollen and brutally beaten, causing Bower to freeze in shock.

entities.name: Bower reacts with fear and backs away into darkness
entities.description: Overcome by fear and confusion upon seeing the corpse, Bower quickly retreats, turns off his light, and fades into the dark as distant thumps are heard approaching.

entities.name: Bower panics and attempts to contact Payton via radio
entities.description: In a state of panic, Bower whispers urgently into the radio, calling out to Payton and demanding a response as he retreats into the dark corridor.

entities.name: next corridor
entities.description: A corridor adjacent to the current location where Bower pauses and observes something unusual.

entities.description: A branching corridor fifty yards away where the out-of-place rounded shape and later the dead man are found.

entities.name: doorway
entities.description: The entrance where the dead man is hanging, marking the location of the disturbing discovery.

entities.name: Man in doorway
entities.description: A dead man found hanging in a doorway, naked and gutted, with a swollen and brutally beaten face, whose unsettling presence causes Bower to react with fear and panic.

document_metadata.title: 31、INT. MESS HALL - LATER
document_metadata.summary: Bower hides under a console, speaking with Payton via radio; they discuss awakened passengers, a violent gang hunting him, and the possibility of others awake on the ship.

entities.name: Bower forces open hatch door and enters mess hall
entities.description: Bower opens a single-paneled hatch door and cautiously enters an institutional-style mess hall with hundreds of tables and chairs, dim lighting, and signs of disarray.

entities.name: Bower observes disheveled mess hall and approaches galley
entities.description: As Bower moves through the mess hall, he notices increasing signs of destruction—overturned chairs, liquid dripping from tables, garbage on the floor—and crawls toward the dimly lit galley.

entities.name: Bower spots figure scavenging in galley
entities.description: From the edge of the counter, Bower peers into the ransacked galley and sees a darkened figure angrily searching through cupboards and throwing empty containers aside.

entities.name: Figure senses Bower and glances back
entities.description: The scavenging figure suddenly pauses, senses Bower's presence, and turns to look back just as Bower ducks to avoid being seen.

entities.name: Bower pulls out envelope opener and prepares to reemerge
entities.description: Bower contemplates his next move, draws an envelope opener as a weapon, and slowly peers out from his hiding spot.

entities.name: Bower is struck in the face and knocked down
entities.description: Bower is suddenly hit in the face with great force, causing blood to spray and knocking him onto his back, losing his pen-lamp and envelope opener.

entities.name: Bower is grabbed by the hair and threatened with a blade
entities.description: While trying to get up, Bower is grabbed by the hair and has a blade pressed against his neck by a woman who growls a command in German.

entities.name: Bower is struck again and silenced
entities.description: When Bower attempts to speak, he is struck again, causing immediate swelling over his eye and silencing him.

entities.name: Nadia kicks away Bower's envelope opener
entities.description: Nadia forcefully kicks the envelope opener away from Bower after subduing him further.

entities.name: Nadia searches Bower and confiscates tools
entities.description: Nadia quickly pats Bower down, taking tools from him while keeping him under threat, only seeing her oil-blackened bare feet with pink-painted toenails.

entities.name: Nadia discovers and discards photograph
entities.description: During the search, Nadia finds a photograph of Evalon, pauses briefly, then throws it aside dismissively.

entities.name: Bower grabs photograph and is shoved
entities.description: Bower reaches for the discarded photograph, prompting Nadia to shove the blade deeper into his neck and threaten him again.

entities.name: Nadia demands Bower remove his shoes
entities.description: Nadia orders Bower to take off his shoes under threat of being gutted, escalating the confrontation.

entities.name: Bower complies with demand to remove shoes
entities.description: After initial resistance, Bower agrees to remove his shoes, telling Nadia to calm down as he submits to her demands.

entities.name: mess hall
entities.description: An institutional-style mess hall with hundreds of lunch tables and chairs, serving as the primary setting where Bower enters and encounters Nadia.

entities.name: galley
entities.description: A sub-area within the mess hall, described as horribly ransacked, where a figure is scavenging and where Bower observes from the edge of the counter.

entities.name: Nadia
entities.description: A woman encountered in the mess hall who attacks and interrogates Bower, wearing a torn jumpsuit and smeared with oil, with white hair and pink toenail polish, speaking with a German accent.
entities.summary: A woman with white hair, a torn jumpsuit, and a German accent confronts Bower, attacks him, and later guides a group through underground corridors, displaying leadership and suspicion toward Bower's intentions.

entities.name: envelope opener
entities.description: A tool carried by Bower that he pulls out for defense and is later kicked away and confiscated by Nadia.

entities.name: pen-lamp
entities.description: A small lighting device carried by Bower that spins away when he is struck in the face.

entities.name: photograph
entities.description: A picture of Evalon that Bower carries, which is discovered and discarded by Nadia but then grabbed back by Bower.

entities.name: blade
entities.description: A sharp weapon used by Nadia to threaten Bower, pressing it against his neck during the confrontation.

entities.name: Bower begins removing shoes and radio crackles with Payton's voice
entities.description: Bower starts taking off his shoes when the radio on his belt suddenly activates, emitting static and a call from Payton, breaking the silence and escalating tension in the mess hall.

entities.name: Bower lunges and initiates violent struggle with Nadia
entities.description: Upon hearing the radio, Bower lunges at Nadia, triggering a chaotic physical confrontation that sends them spinning into a table, initiating a fierce fight in the dimly lit mess hall.

entities.name: Bower is struck and sent flying during fight with Nadia
entities.description: During the struggle, Bower is hit hard by Nadia, causing him to be thrown across the room where he lands and looks up at her approaching silhouette with a weapon.

entities.name: Bower pleads with Nadia to stop attacking
entities.description: After being struck, Bower shouts desperately at Nadia to cease her assault, attempting to de-escalate the violent encounter through verbal appeal.

entities.name: Nadia continues attack and Bower defends with thrown objects
entities.description: Ignoring Bower's pleas, Nadia persists in her assault, prompting Bower to frantically hurl dishes and chairs in self-defense to create distance and block her advances.

entities.name: Nadia throws blade that glances off Bower's forearm
entities.description: Nadia hurls her edged weapon at Bower, but it strikes the blunt side against his forearm, deflecting without causing a serious injury but intensifying the danger of the confrontation.

entities.name: Bower uses shoe as improvised weapon against Nadia
entities.description: With no other tools available, Bower grabs his shoe and wields it defensively as a weapon, surprising Nadia and momentarily halting her aggression.

entities.name: Nadia stops attacking and retreats in fear
entities.description: After Bower brandishes the shoe, Nadia abruptly ceases her assault and begins backing away, visibly frightened, her attention shifting past Bower to something behind him.

entities.name: Bluish glow appears at doorway and figure approaches with flaming spear
entities.description: A mysterious bluish light seeps into the mess hall from the corridor, heralding the entrance of an unknown figure carrying a spear-like device tipped with a blazing blue flame powered by a chemical sprayer.

entities.name: Nadia flees into kitchen upon seeing approaching figure
entities.description: As the glowing figure enters, Nadia immediately abandons the confrontation and sprints toward the galley, disappearing into the kitchen in apparent fear of the newcomer.

entities.name: Bower ducks below tables as figure enters with flaming weapon
entities.description: Reacting to the threat posed by the newcomer's illuminated spear, Bower drops beneath the tables for cover, seeking concealment as the unknown figure advances into the mess hall.

entities.name: moments later
entities.description: A short relative temporal reference indicating immediate succession of events following a prior action in the scene.

entities.description: A connecting passage adjacent to the mess hall from which a bluish glow and a figure approach.

entities.name: Tribal warrior inspects corners with flaming device

entities.description: Weasel, a smaller hunter with war paint and scars, approaches Bower's location, sniffing the air like a tracking animal and nearly discovering him.

entities.description: Just as Weasel is about to locate Bower, Heflin emits a sharp hiss that signals Weasel to abandon his search and return to the group.

entities.name: Heflin
entities.description: The leader of a group of tribal hunters, distinguished by his size and strength, who commands the others using vocal signals like hisses and cackles.

He struggles physically, requires support, and takes charge at the control desk before deciding to leave due to power failures and strange noises, expressing caution about descending into a narrow shaft.

document_metadata.title: 44、INT. CORRIDOR
document_metadata.summary: Bower confronts Shepard, who defies orders and flees as blue torches and approaching hunters appear; Bower hesitates, then runs after Shepard, overwhelmed by fear.

entities.name: Bower discovers Shepard trapped in a wire snare
entities.description: Bower, exploring a corridor with a flashlight, comes across a body tangled in a wire snare and realizes it is Shepard, a member of team six, who is still alive but severely injured and traumatized.

entities.name: Shepard awakens and screams in terror
entities.description: As Bower approaches, Shepard suddenly opens his eyes and begins screaming uncontrollably, reacting with extreme fear and panic as if caught in a trap, forcing Bower to subdue him.

entities.name: Bower strikes Shepard to stop his screaming
entities.description: To silence Shepard's frantic screams that could attract danger, Bower punches him in the gut, knocking the wind out of him and causing him to collapse silently onto the floor.

entities.name: Bower frees Shepard from the wire snare
entities.description: Bower carefully pulls on the wire connected to a nearby doorway's hydraulics, causing the snare to snap and release Shepard, who falls to the floor gasping for air.

entities.name: Shepard reacts violently to Bower's attempt to help
entities.description: When Bower kneels to assist, Shepard shrieks and tries to scramble away, reacting with extreme sensitivity and trauma to physical contact, indicating deep psychological distress.

entities.name: Bower identifies Shepard as member of team six
entities.description: Using his flashlight, Bower sees Shepard's identification tattoo through his torn uniform and bloodied bandages, confirming he is part of team six, the unit expected to follow their group.

entities.description: Bower uses the radio to calm Shepard, telling him he won't be hurt and that he'll be alright, attempting to establish trust and communication.

entities.description: Upon realizing Bower is not from a rescue team but another team member who just woke up, Shepard's expression changes, his face pales, and his demeanor shifts to one of bitter impatience and urgency.

document_metadata.title: 45、INT. FILTRATION COMPARTMENT - MOMENTS LATER
document_metadata.summary: Bower's weapon discharges, shattering surroundings but failing to penetrate glass; Heflin, the lead Hunter, remains unimpressed and commands his team to pursue Bower, who flees.

entities.name: Bower struggles to follow Shepard through a compartment with glass dividers
entities.description: Bower attempts to pursue Shepard through a compartment filled with filtration units and piping, but collides with thick glass dividers that separate the space, forcing him to change direction.

entities.name: Shepard crawls into a ventilation shaft to escape
entities.description: Shepard locates and enters a vent to evade capture, disappearing from Bower's immediate view.

entities.name: Blue torch and running feet pass by the compartment doorway
entities.description: A blue torch light moves past the doorway accompanied by the sound of bare feet running across steel, indicating the approach of hostile entities.

entities.name: Bower hides under piping and notices his weapon losing power
entities.description: Bower takes cover beneath piping and observes the activation lights on his weapon dimming, signaling low energy.

entities.name: Bower attempts to manually recharge his weapon
entities.description: To restore power, Bower quietly turns the energy lever on his weapon, but the resulting whine appears dangerously loud in the confined space.

entities.name: Bower and Shepard exchange a silent signal
entities.description: Bower makes eye contact with Shepard, who is hiding behind a console twenty feet away, and Shepard mouths a warning not to follow and angrily waves him off.

entities.name: Shepard is captured by a wire noose around his neck
entities.description: A wire noose suddenly snaps tight around Shepard's neck, attached to a pole-and-wire rig similar to an alligator snare, restricting his movement.

entities.name: Shepard runs wildly while restrained by a thirty-foot wire leash
entities.description: After the wire is released from its rig, Shepard thrashes and runs in panic, dragging a thirty-foot wire that loops and tangles around nearby piping.

entities.name: Hunters converge from multiple directions with whirling blades
entities.description: Multiple Hunters emerge from all sides of the compartment, advancing on Shepard with spinning blades, surrounding him.

entities.name: Hunters attack and begin feeding on Shepard
entities.description: The Hunters swarm over Shepard, intensifying their assault as screams fill the air, and they begin to feed on his body.

entities.name: Shepard's neck is twisted until it snaps
entities.description: During the violent attack, Shepard's neck is forcibly twisted to the point of breaking, resulting in his death.

entities.name: Bower cranks his weapon and emerges from hiding
entities.description: Enraged by the attack, Bower aggressively turns the energy lever on his weapon and exits his hiding place to confront the Hunters.

entities.name: Bower aims at the lead Hunter but the weapon jams
entities.description: Bower takes aim at the back of the lead Hunter, only fifteen feet away, but the weapon fails upon pulling the trigger, producing only a screech of rusted metal.

entities.description: An interior section of the facility containing filtration equipment and a network of pipes, where Bower attempts to follow Shepard.

entities.description: A device carried by Bower that uses an energy lever for activation but eventually jams during a critical moment.

entities.description: A wire-based restraint that captures Shepard around the neck, functioning like a pole and wire rig used for capturing alligators.

entities.name: energy lever
entities.description: A component on Bower's weapon that must be manually cranked to activate or recharge the device.

entities.description: Thick transparent barriers that separate sections of the compartment, causing Bower to change direction when he collides with one.

entities.description: A network of tubes and conduits within the compartment that Bower uses for cover and that entangles the wire leash during Shepard's capture.

entities.name: Hunters
entities.summary: Pursuers with unnatural abilities chase Bower and close in on a group investigating sounds and a loose cable; the group later returns with weapons, performing a ritualistic attack and consumption of the Big Passenger.

entities.name: Bower panics and accidentally discharges his weapon
entities.description: Bower, in a state of panic, grabs his weapon with both hands, checks for a safety switch, and unintentionally fires it, releasing a powerful blast of energy to the side.

entities.name: Energy blast shatters surroundings and knocks objects over
entities.description: The weapon's discharge creates an electrical explosion that cracks like lightning, echoes like thunder, and produces shockwaves that shatter fragile items and topple unsecured objects within a thirty-foot radius.

entities.name: Hunters turn toward Bower upon hearing the blast
entities.description: Startled by the sound and impact of the energy blast, the Hunters shift their attention and position to face Bower's location.

entities.name: Heflin reveals himself as the lead Hunter
entities.description: The lead Hunter steps forward, revealing his identity as Heflin, a physically imposing figure with glistening hydraulic fluid on his skin, tribal scars, war paint, and predatory body language.

entities.name: Bower recharges his weapon and fires at Heflin
entities.description: Bower frantically cranks the energy lever to prepare his weapon, aims it at Heflin, and fires a thunderous shot that strikes the glass divider between them.

entities.name: Glass divider absorbs energy blast and shudders
entities.description: The safety glass between Bower and Heflin successfully absorbs the impact of the energy blast, causing a visible shudder to ripple through the ship's hull.

entities.name: Heflin remains unfazed and advances on Bower
entities.description: After being targeted, Heflin shows no reaction to the blast, slowly lowers his head and lifts his shoulders in a reptilian motion, then steps closer while emitting a hiss.

entities.name: Heflin commands Hunters to pursue Bower
entities.description: Heflin issues a silent or vocal command for the Hunters to chase Bower, prompting them to swarm in all directions in search of a path around the glass barrier.

entities.name: Bower flees from the Hunters
entities.description: Realizing he is surrounded and outmatched, Bower turns and runs to escape the advancing Hunters who are closing in from multiple directions.

entities.name: Ventilation shaft panel bends and falls to the floor
entities.description: The metal vent panel rattles and begins to bend under pressure from inside the shaft, eventually falling to the floor after the screwdriver holding it snaps.

entities.name: Payton prepares to defend himself with a pipe
entities.description: After the vent panel falls, Payton raises a metal pipe in a defensive stance, ready to fight whatever emerges from the ventilation shaft.

entities.name: Gallo emerges from the ventilation shaft and begs for help
entities.description: Gallo, a young flight officer visibly distressed and coated in sweat, gasps for help from inside the shaft, identifying himself as part of the flight crew.

entities.name: Payton pulls Gallo out of the ventilation shaft
entities.description: After a moment of hesitation, Payton lowers his weapon, reaches into the shaft, grabs Gallo's hand, and pulls him out to safety.

entities.name: Gallo collapses on the floor in a state of shock
entities.description: Once pulled out, Gallo collapses onto the floor, curling into a fetal position, trembling, with claw-like hand grips and rapid, unsteady breathing indicating extreme physical and psychological distress.

entities.name: Payton
entities.description: A man who is awakened from sleep by noises in the ventilation shaft and initially prepares to defend himself before helping another character emerge.
entities.summary: A lieutenant from Flight Team Five awakens in a sealed sleep pod aboard the Elysium, disoriented and suffering memory loss. He struggles physically, requires support, and takes charge at the control desk before deciding to leave due to power failures and strange noises, expressing caution about descending into a narrow shaft.

entities.name: Gallo
entities.description: A young flight officer with dark brown hair, heavily coated in sweat and showing signs of fear and exhaustion, who emerges from the ventilation shaft pleading for help.
entities.summary: Crew members aboard a spacecraft show signs of fear, injury, and psychological distress while recounting traumatic events, including Earth's destruction and a crisis at Flight Team Four, as they struggle with Pandorum symptoms and delayed revelations.

entities.description: When Payton kneels to assist him, Gallo involuntarily jerks and convulses in response to physical contact, indicating trauma or injury.

entities.description: Payton lifts a bottle to Gallo's lips in an effort to hydrate him, but the water runs down Gallo's face as he remains unresponsive.

entities.description: Under prompting from Payton, Gallo weakly identifies himself by name, showing signs of disorientation and distress.

document_metadata.summary: The group hears distant thumps in the damaged hyper-sleep chamber; Tanaka detects a threat and follows it into the shadows while Bower and Nadia flee to avoid danger.

document_metadata.summary: Bower, Nadia, and Tanaka flee as the room fills with Hunters alerted by metal sounds; Heflin and his pack pause to devour a fallen Hunter before pursuing.

entities.name: Bower emerges into a damaged passenger processing center
entities.description: Bower exits the barricades and enters a darkened, disordered facility intended for loading passengers, indicating a state of abandonment or destruction.

entities.name: Nadia scouts ahead while Bower rushes to follow
entities.description: Nadia moves forward cautiously, assessing the path through the corridors, while Bower hurries to catch up with her.

entities.name: Bower insists on waiting for the missing team member
entities.description: Bower argues that they cannot abandon a teammate who saved his life, expressing loyalty and concern for group cohesion.

entities.name: Nadia refuses to wait and continues forward
entities.description: Nadia declares she will not delay, fearing for her own survival, and asserts her decision to move on without the missing member.

entities.name: Nadia abandons Bower and advances into a dark tunnel
entities.description: Nadia moves deeper into the facility, entering a narrowing, poorly lit tunnel, leaving Bower momentarily behind.

entities.description: Faced with a difficult choice, Bower decides to abandon waiting and turns to chase after Nadia.

entities.description: Both characters navigate a confined, complex space filled with industrial equipment, with Nadia moving at a pace that challenges Bower.

entities.description: While crawling, Bower steps on and then identifies a small white object as a human finger bone, triggering shock and dread.

entities.name: Bower and Nadia discover a pit filled with human remains
entities.description: Upon closer inspection, they realize they are surrounded by massive piles of skeletons and carcasses, revealing the horrifying nature of their location.

entities.name: Bower and Nadia crawl up a slope of dead bodies in panic
entities.description: Trapped with no forward or lateral escape, they begin moving upward over a mound of human remains, horrified but compelled to proceed.

entities.name: Bower expresses horror at their location and direction
entities.description: Crawling over the remains, Bower cries out in disbelief and fear, questioning where they are going and what they have entered.

entities.name: darkened and narrowing tunnel
entities.description: A confined, poorly lit passage that Nadia enters and Bower follows into, leading deeper from the processing center.

entities.name: maze of machinery
entities.description: A cluttered, complex space filled with mechanical equipment through which Bower and Nadia crawl.

entities.name: pit of human remains
entities.description: A large depression filled with skeletons and carcasses that Bower and Nadia inadvertently enter.

entities.name: slope of dead remains
entities.description: An incline formed by accumulated corpses that Bower and Nadia must crawl up to escape the pit.

entities.name: Payton Bower
entities.description: A team member who emerges into a damaged passenger processing center and insists on waiting for a missing teammate before following Nadia into a dark tunnel.
entities.summary: A man awakens in a derelict spacecraft with no memory, discovers his identity via a tattoo and locker, and is assisted by a corporal who awoke earlier to manage systems and support him.

entities.name: Nadia
entities.description: A team member who scouts ahead in a damaged facility, refuses to wait for a missing teammate, and leads the way into a dark tunnel and machinery maze filled with human remains.
entities.summary: A woman with white hair, a torn jumpsuit, and a German accent confronts Bower, attacks him, and later guides a group through underground corridors, displaying leadership and suspicion toward Bower's intentions.

entities.name: missing team member
entities.description: A fellow team member who has gone ahead into unknown territory and is believed by Bower to have saved his life previously, prompting Bower's reluctance to abandon him.

entities.name: human finger bone
entities.description: A small white object found underfoot by Bower, later identified as a human finger bone, indicating the presence of human remains in the area.

entities.name: Nadia grabs Bower to silence him as a shadow passes with a hissing sound
entities.description: Nadia suddenly grabs Bower, jerking him to keep him quiet as a shadow moves past accompanied by a cackling hiss, forcing them to freeze in place atop the remains.

entities.name: Bower and Nadia freeze as a Hunter appears silhouetted on a rafter above them
entities.description: They remain motionless on the slope of remains as they look up and see a Hunter crouched like a gargoyle on a rafter, leering down at them.

entities.name: The slope of remains begins to slide due to movement and pressure
entities.description: As Bower and Nadia try to stay still, the pile of bones beneath them crinkles and shifts, initiating a small landslide.

entities.name: A power surge triggers a landslide of bones and flesh
entities.description: A shuddering power surge with flickering lights destabilizes the hill of remains, causing a larger landslide that sends Bower and Nadia sliding uncontrollably to the bottom.

entities.name: Bower raises his weapon to find the Hunter has disappeared
entities.description: After sliding to a stop, Bower quickly aims his weapon at the rafters only to discover that the Hunter is no longer there.

entities.name: The Hunter lunges at Bower and Nadia from close range
entities.description: As Nadia whispers about the Hunter's disappearance, it suddenly roars and attacks from five feet away, striking Bower with great force.

entities.name: Bower is thrown into a pile of bones by the Hunter's attack
entities.description: The force of the Hunter's strike sends Bower flying into a heap of bones, separating him from Nadia.

entities.name: Nadia attempts to defend herself with a bladed pipe but is struck from behind
entities.description: Nadia spins around wielding a bladed pipe, but before she can act, she is hit from behind and slammed into the floor with tremendous force.

entities.name: The Hunter pounces on Nadia and prepares to attack her neck
entities.description: After knocking Nadia down, the Hunter leaps onto her back, grabs her hair with a clawed hand, and opens its jaws toward her neck.

entities.name: Bower tackles the Hunter to save Nadia
entities.description: At the last moment, Bower charges into the Hunter, knocking it off Nadia and initiating a violent, close-quarters fight under flickering light.

entities.name: Bower and the Hunter engage in a brutal fight under flickering light
entities.description: Bower and the Hunter grapple in a distorted, intense struggle, illuminated intermittently by unstable lighting in the chamber.

entities.name: pile of bones
entities.description: A localized accumulation of skeletal remains where Bower is thrown after being struck by the Hunter.

entities.name: rafters

document_metadata.title: 63、INT. SLEEP CHAMBER/CONTROL DESK - LATER
document_metadata.summary: Gallo, traumatized and defensive, claims his crew succumbed to Pandorum, forcing him to kill them in self-defense; Payton remains skeptical, arms himself discreetly while monitoring Gallo's unstable state.

entities.name: Payton checks Gallo for a pulse and inspects his identification tattoo
entities.description: Payton cautiously approaches the unconscious Gallo, checks his neck for a pulse, notices dried blood under his nose, and gently pulls back the blanket to examine Gallo's identification tattoo, which reads 'FLT>>004>>012'.

entities.name: Gallo awakens and confronts Payton
entities.description: As Payton inspects him, Gallo suddenly opens his eyes and demands to know what Payton is doing, responding with suspicion and discomfort when told he was being checked on.

entities.name: Payton identifies Gallo as a member of Flight Team Four
entities.description: After reading Gallo's identification tattoo, Payton mutters to himself that Gallo belongs to Team Four and appears confused, noting that Gallo was supposed to be his predecessor.

entities.name: Payton attempts to calm Gallo during an emotional outburst
entities.description: When Gallo becomes agitated and raises his voice while refusing to answer navigation questions, Payton senses he is close to breaking down and shifts to a calmer tone to de-escalate the situation.

entities.name: Gallo hides his trembling hands under the blanket
entities.description: As Payton expresses concern for his well-being, Gallo tucks his shaking hands beneath the blanket in a defensive gesture, insisting he is fine despite visible distress.

entities.name: Payton notices dried blood on Gallo's legs and questions its origin
entities.description: After observing Gallo's condition, Payton lowers his gaze to see dried blood splattered on Gallo's legs and asks whether it is his blood, addressing him as 'Corporal'.

entities.summary: A lieutenant from Flight Team Five awakens in a sealed sleep pod aboard the Elysium, disoriented and suffering memory loss. He struggles physically, requires support, and takes charge at the control desk before deciding to leave due to power failures and strange noises, expressing caution about descending into a narrow shaft.

entities.description: A corporal and member of Flight Team Four who has just awakened, disoriented and emotionally unstable, with visible signs of injury and distress.

document_metadata.title: 65、INT. TANK - CONT.
document_metadata.summary: A spark ignites gas, knocking Leland down; Bower forces him to shut off the gas flow using a weapon, which impresses Leland.

entities.name: Nadia steps through the hatch triggering a wire trap
entities.description: As Nadia enters the tank, her movement activates a hidden wire that triggers a mechanical trap, causing the hatch to slam shut and trapping the group inside.

entities.name: Gas is released into the tank through wall vents
entities.description: After the hatch is sealed, a lever is activated remotely, releasing a stream of colorless, suffocating gas from vents along the tank walls, causing the occupants to choke and panic.

entities.name: Tanaka attempts to climb out of the tank using a pipe
entities.description: In response to the gas and entrapment, Tanaka runs up the slanted wall, dives, and grabs a pipe to climb toward the catwalk in an attempt to escape.

entities.name: Leland jabs Tanaka's hand with a spear to stop his escape
entities.description: From the catwalk, Leland uses a spear to attack Tanaka's hand, forcing him to lose his grip and fall back to the bottom of the tank.

entities.name: Bower fires energy weapon at the hatch to break it open
entities.description: Bower positions his weapon at near point-blank range, activates the magneto lever, and fires a powerful energy blast at the hatch, sending an electric jolt through the tank in an attempt to breach the door.

entities.name: Figure is seen moving across the catwalk in the shadows
entities.description: Bower shines his light toward the catwalk and observes a shadowy figure (later identified as Leland) moving quickly through the darkness above the tank.

entities.name: Bower pulls Nadir away from the hatch for safety
entities.description: As the situation escalates, Bower physically moves Nadir away from the hatch to protect him from potential danger during the confrontation.

entities.description: An enclosed industrial tank with slanted walls, valves, and filtration screens, serving as the primary setting for the scene's events.

entities.description: An overhead walkway surrounding the tank, housing hidden speakers and providing access for movement above the scene.

entities.name: wall vents
entities.description: Vents embedded in the walls of the tank through which gas is released during the trap activation.

entities.description: An entry point to the tank that slams shut when the wire trap is triggered, becoming a focal point for escape attempts.

entities.description: The inclined interior surfaces of the tank that characters attempt to climb during their escape efforts.

document_metadata.summary: Leland, a reclusive subletter in a tank, refuses to come down due to hygiene fears, sends food, and reacts suspiciously when asked about the reactor bay, hinting the newcomers just woke up.

document_metadata.title: 89、INT. REACTOR BAY - CONT.
document_metadata.summary: Bower reaches a control panel above sleeping Hunters; a falling pen-lamp alerts one, which resumes sleep. He tries switches, pumps a primer, and the panel flickers. Nadia rescues him as Leland flees in fear.

entities.name: Crew emerges onto catwalks above a dark reactor shaft
entities.description: The characters crawl out onto the top of a massive cylindrical shaft, surrounded by numerous catwalks with an abyss of darkness below them, marking the beginning of their descent into the reactor bay.

entities.name: Bower detects a significant odor and declares the location
entities.description: Bower senses a distinct odor and announces that they have reached their target location, urging the team to descend before others return.

entities.name: Leland experiences paralyzing fear at the site entrance
entities.description: Leland is overcome with terror upon seeing the reactor shaft, referring to it as the 'House of the Keepers' and a descent into Hell, refusing to move forward.

entities.name: Bower begins descent into the reactor shaft despite Leland's protests
entities.description: Ignoring Leland's pleas, Bower starts climbing down a ladder into the darkness, initiating the team's descent into the reactor bay.

entities.name: Tanaka and Nadia follow Bower past Leland
entities.description: Tanaka and Nadia push past the immobilized Leland and begin descending the ladder after Bower, continuing the team's movement into the reactor shaft.

entities.name: Nadia orders Leland to stop protesting and move
entities.description: As Leland continues to resist, Nadia sharply commands him to be quiet and follow, asserting urgency and authority in the tense situation.

entities.name: Leland remains at the top while others descend
entities.description: Leland stays behind at the entrance of the shaft, watching in fear as the rest of the team begins their dangerous descent along the algae-coated catwalks.

entities.name: Team navigates increasingly dense algae-covered catwalks
entities.description: The descending characters cling to pipes and railings as they move down the reactor bay walls, encountering thicker growths of oddly colored algae and a growing dim glow from below.

entities.name: Bower leaps across a gap in the catwalk
entities.description: Encountering a break in the walkway, Bower jumps over the gap, nearly losing his grip and risking a fall into the darkness below.

entities.name: Bower observes unidentifiable white shapes near the reactor base
entities.description: From his vantage point, Bower sees strange white patterns near the bottom of the shaft but cannot determine their nature, prompting him to descend further.

entities.name: Bower reaches a gangplank leading to the reactor
entities.description: Bower successfully descends to a gangplank that spans toward the central reactor structure, positioning himself to approach a darkened control panel.

entities.name: Bower signals for Tanaka and Nadia to hold their position
entities.description: Upon reaching the gangplank, Bower gestures for Tanaka and Nadia to remain where they are while he proceeds alone toward the control panel.

entities.name: Bower begins crawling across the gangplank toward a control panel
entities.description: Bower cautiously moves across the unstable gangplank, heading toward a darkened control panel on the reactor structure for investigation.

entities.name: massive cylinder shaped shaft
entities.description: A large cylindrical shaft with catwalks lining the walls, serving as the primary setting for the team's descent.

entities.name: reactor bay wall
entities.description: The vertical wall structure of the reactor bay where the team descends along catwalks and railings.

entities.name: tall reactor
entities.description: A towering reactor structure connected by a gangplank, serving as a destination point in the scene.

entities.name: darkened control panel
entities.description: A control panel located near the reactor, dimly lit and accessible via a gangplank, indicating a functional station within the shaft.

entities.name: Payton Bower
entities.description: A determined crew member who leads the descent into the reactor shaft despite others' fears and takes initiative to investigate the control panel.
entities.summary: A man awakens in a derelict spacecraft with no memory, discovers his identity via a tattoo and locker, and is assisted by a corporal who awoke earlier to manage systems and support him.

entities.name: Leland
entities.description: A crew member overwhelmed by fear at the entrance of the reactor shaft, refusing to descend and expressing dread about the location.
entities.summary: A mysterious, shadowed figure on the catwalk activates traps and halts Tanaka's escape with a spear; he sublets space on the ship, hosts guests with unsettling charm, prepares soup, narrates stories from wall drawings with dramatic flair, and reveals knowledge of three pilots' fate through poetic monologue.

entities.name: Tanaka
entities.description: A crew member who follows Bower down into the reactor shaft and supports the mission despite the danger.
entities.summary: A Japanese man with a rugged physique and identification tattoos communicates non-verbally with Bower, assists the crew in opening a sealed door, intervenes in a fight, and is targeted by Nadia before being restrained during a panic as hunters approach.

entities.name: Nadia
entities.description: A crew member who follows Bower into the reactor shaft and commands Leland to stop protesting and move forward.
entities.summary: A woman with white hair, a torn jumpsuit, and a German accent confronts Bower, attacks him, and later guides a group through underground corridors, displaying leadership and suspicion toward Bower's intentions.

entities.name: ladder
entities.description: A metal structure used by the crew to begin their descent down the reactor bay wall into the shaft.

entities.name: gangplank
entities.description: A narrow plank extending toward the reactor that Bower crosses to reach a control panel.

entities.name: control panel
entities.description: A darkened interface located near the reactor that Bower attempts to reach and potentially activate.

entities.name: algae
entities.description: Odd-colored, dense growth covering the catwalks and pipes in the reactor shaft, glowing faintly in the dark.

entities.name: House of the Keepers
entities.description: A feared and ominous place referenced by Leland, associated with damnation and horror, possibly linked to the reactor site.

entities.name: Pen-lamp falls from Leland's belt and clanks onto the catwalk
entities.description: While leaning over the railing, Leland's pen-lamp slips from his belt, strikes a catwalk, and begins to fall toward the reactor floor.

entities.name: Pen-lamp illuminates field of sleeping Hunters at reactor base
entities.description: The falling pen-lamp lands on the floor, briefly lighting up dozens of pale, intertwined Hunters who appear to be in a dormant, sleep-like state.

entities.name: Hunter awakens and detects intruders by scent
entities.description: The sound and light from the falling pen-lamp cause one Hunter to instantly rise and sniff the air, alert to the presence of the crew above.

entities.name: Bower remains frozen on gangplank above sleeping Hunters
entities.description: After witnessing the Hunter react, Bower stops moving and clings to the gangplank, suspended twenty feet above the dormant Hunters.

entities.name: Hunter returns to sleep and re-enters mass of bodies
entities.description: After detecting no immediate threat, the Hunter slowly slides back into the cluster of sleeping forms, resuming its dormant state.

entities.name: Bower continues crawl and reaches control panel
entities.description: Once the Hunter has returned to sleep, Bower resumes moving across the gangplank and successfully reaches the control panel on the reactor bay wall.

entities.name: Leland retreats from reactor bay in fear
entities.description: After seeing the mass of sleeping Hunters, Leland becomes overwhelmed with fear and backs away, exiting the reactor bay.

entities.name: Tanaka and Nadia watch Bower from ladder in tense silence
entities.description: Tanaka and Nadia remain on the ladders, gripping them tightly and holding their breath as they observe Bower's precarious movement across the gangplank.

entities.name: Bower loses grip and dangles from broken vine
entities.description: While attempting to stabilize himself, Bower grabs a vine that breaks, causing him to lose his footing and dangle over the edge of the gangplank.

entities.name: Nadia jumps gap and extends weapon to rescue Bower
entities.description: Nadia crosses the gap between catwalks and climbs down to reach Bower, offering her weapon for him to grab as a lifeline.

entities.name: Bower and Nadia cling to reactor side together
entities.description: After being rescued, Bower and Nadia both hang from the side of the reactor structure, stabilizing themselves before returning to the control panel.

entities.name: Bower attempts to activate control panel with no response
entities.description: Bower tries to operate the switches on the control panel, but the system does not respond, prompting growing concern.

entities.name: Bower pumps primer switch and control panel lights flicker
entities.description: In response to the failed activation, Bower manually operates a primer switch, causing the dusty control panel lights to weakly flicker to life.

entities.name: catwalks
entities.description: Elevated walkways above the reactor shaft where the crew is positioned and where the pen-lamp clanks during its fall.

entities.name: bottom of the reactor shaft
entities.description: The base area of the reactor shaft where the pen-lamp lands and illuminates the field of sleeping Hunters.

entities.name: field of sleeping Hunters
entities.description: The area covered with intertwined pale bodies of dormant Hunters at the base of the reactor.

entities.name: side of the reactor
entities.description: The exterior surface of the reactor where Bower and Nadia cling after the rescue.

entities.name: moments later
entities.description: A short temporal progression indicating the immediate aftermath of the Hunter returning to sleep and Bower resuming his crawl.

entities.name: Hunters
entities.description: A pale, white creature that sleeps in a mass at the reactor base and awakens by scent when intruders are near; exhibits animalistic guarding behavior.
entities.summary: Hostile entities including predatory creatures and armed figures operate in a hostile environment, attacking individuals like Shepard, Bower, Nadia, and Tanaka, with some exhibiting animalistic, resilient, and coordinated behaviors.

entities.name: vine
entities.description: A plant growth used by Bower for support during descent, which breaks under his weight causing him to dangle.

entities.description: Upon hitting the wall, Gallo physically ages and his voice deepens, addressing Payton as 'Corporal' and suggesting a shared identity.

entities.name: Payton slams Gallo against the wall repeatedly
entities.description: Payton forcefully slams Gallo into the wall multiple times, each impact causing Gallo to age further and resemble Payton more closely.

entities.description: As he ages, Gallo asserts that Payton's mind is in conflict with itself, reinforcing the psychological and physical merging of their identities.

entities.name: Gallo and Payton's tattoos are revealed as identical

entities.name: Syringe injects chemical into one of the men

entities.name: Gallo and Payton's voices merge into one
entities.description: As the injection takes effect, the voices of Gallo and Payton overlap and gradually become indistinguishable, speaking in unison.

entities.name: Gallo and Payton speak in unison about the necessity of the shot
entities.description: The two men, now seemingly unified in voice and identity, declare together that the injection was 'for the best, Corporal'.

entities.summary: A lieutenant from Flight Team Five awakens in a sealed sleep pod aboard the Elysium, disoriented and suffering memory loss. He struggles physically, requires support, and takes charge at the control desk before deciding to leave due to power failures and strange noises, expressing caution about descending into a narrow shaft.

document_metadata.title: 103、INT. COMMAND BRIDGE - CONT.
document_metadata.summary: Gallo attacks Nadia, but a sudden water explosion bursts through the cracked window, throwing everyone apart and halting the confrontation.

entities.name: Bower discovers Gallo seated in the flight control chair
entities.description: Bower, after hearing Nadia's gasp, turns toward the flight control chair and sees Gallo sitting motionless, leading to a tense confrontation as Bower draws his weapon and approaches.

entities.name: Flight computer displays elapsed time from launch
entities.description: Bower accesses the flight log on the control console, triggering the computer to scroll through the time-code from launch, rapidly showing the passage of months turning into years.

entities.name: Nadia reacts to discovering a figure in the control chair
entities.description: As Nadia approaches the cockpit windows, she suddenly notices a motionless figure seated in one of the flight control chairs and jumps back in fright, alerting Bower to the presence.

entities.name: Bower confronts Gallo about identity and deception
entities.description: Bower questions Gallo about his true identity, accusing him of being from team four and switching bunks to hide something, demanding to know why he assumed a false identity.

entities.name: Gallo reveals shared memory loss with Bower
entities.description: Gallo responds to Bower's accusation by stating that his own memory lapse has also ended, indicating mutual amnesia and a return of suppressed memories.

entities.name: Bower identifies Gallo through tattoo on neck
entities.description: As Bower approaches Gallo from behind, he notices the identification tattoo on Gallo's neck bearing the serial code FLT>>004>>012>>, confirming his identity.

entities.name: Nadia expresses awe and confusion about their situation
entities.description: Upon entering the flight bridge, Nadia voices her shock and disorientation, questioning what has happened to them and their current location in space.

entities.name: Bower activates weapon with laser sight aimed at Gallo
entities.description: After spotting Gallo, Bower readies his weapon by cranking the lever, activating the magnetos and illuminating the laser sight that locks onto Gallo's back.

entities.name: Gallo reflects on lifelong experience aboard the ship
